name: e-Approval
nameTh: อนุมัติออนไลน์
description: Online approval (e-Approval / e-Memo) for any organisation: request types with a default multi-step approver chain, numbered requests (APV-2569-0001) routed approver by approver, locked approver chains, delegation while an approver is away, approve / reject / return-for-edit / cancel / comment with a full audit trail, a personal inbox on web and mobile, and a dashboard of decision speed.

permissions.label: ดูใบขออนุมัติของตนเองและที่ต้องอนุมัติ
